## 金融 AI 检查 · Financial AI Checklist

- [ ] 主持人仍不作为第四位投票者 / The moderator remains a non-voting coordinator
- [ ] A 股与港美股的分析框架仍正确区分 / A-share and HK/U.S. frameworks remain distinct
- [ ] 非模拟分析仅使用用户 MCP 数据并保留来源 / Non-simulated analysis uses only attributed user MCP data
- [ ] 模拟内容有明确标记 / Simulated content is explicitly labeled
- [ ] 不包含投资收益承诺或自动荐股表达 / No guaranteed-return or automatic stock-picking claims are introduced
- [ ] 不包含 API Key、MCP token、真实客户数据或敏感日志 / No API keys, MCP tokens, real client data, or sensitive logs are included
